STATS::get
Description
Retrieves the value of the specified field of the specified Statistics
profile.
Syntax
STATS
::
get
<
profile
>
<
field
>
STATS::get <profile> <field>
Retrieves the value of the specified field of the specified
Statistics profile.
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
if
{[
string
tolower
[
HTTP
::
uri
]]
starts_with
"/check"
}
{
STATS
::
get
stats_profile_1
"my_first_field"
}
}
